source.commit_body:
Score-stage fix for Priority #6 (2023 signal density anomaly): on objectively-
bull-mislabeled-stress days the regime composite mislabels narrow-bull tape as
STRESS (mult ~0.7), compressing ~2,689 alpha-rich calls in 2023 (option-TP
~64.8%) and amplifying ~5,774 zero-EV puts (option-TP ~43.5%). The softener
pulls call-side regime_multiplier toward 1.0 by (mis_stress * 0.25) only when
(a) (spy_wk_composite - regime_composite) > 0, and (b) objective bull state
holds (SPY > EMA200, VIX < 20, SPY_10d > 0). Bull-objective gate filters out
SPY-weekly lag artifacts; per-trade evidence shows put pulled-in cohorts have
native-quality WR so the softener is asymmetric (calls only).

Validated 2026-04-25 via Phase-A full-pipeline simulator sweep:
  22-now CALL75+ N +5.6% (2141->2261)  WR15 +0.2pp (74.9->75.1%)
  2024 (clean bull) +0.1pp WR (no v22 trap)
  2022 (real bear) +1 call only (clean no-op via objective-bull gate)
  ms-cohort newly-admitted WR=76.0% > baseline 74.5%

Files:
- database/utils/scoring.py: MIS_STRESS_CALL_DAMPEN=0.25 + softener at regime
  application step + mis_stress field in weight_info for explain-scores audits
- database/models/core.py: _load_mis_stress_map() helper, plumbed through both
  score-write paths and reapply_regime_today
- simulator.py: builds _mis_stress_map at init, passes mis_stress= per-date
- experiments/ct_designs.py: 'mis_stress_call_softener' design for sweeps
- experiments/design_d_regime_link.py + post_hoc + softener_sweep: validation
  scripts and outputs preserved for forensics

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
